{{Top|leg}}
A '''com-box''' was a communications device that utilized [[fiber-optic]] cables routed through a central switching [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. They were employed when atmospheric or geological conditions prevented the use of [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], such as in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Neskroff/Legends|Neskroff]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]].
